purpose: Map authoritative BRTI time support for every fixed calibration checkpoint and settlement window without reading, parsing, deriving, or outputting any BRTI value.

timestamp_extraction.method: Scan decompressed raw bytes only for the exact JSON key token "time" followed by an integer. Do not deserialize the payload, access the value key, convert a value string, or compute any price statistic.
timestamp_extraction.receipt_crosscheck: The number of extracted exact time fields must equal the structurally validated payload_count in the sealed V3 acquisition receipt.
raw_time_guards: Strictly ascending and unique within each requested hour.
Inside the exact half-open requested hour.

support_rules.current_source_selection: Latest projected one-second timestamp <= information_cutoff, with cutoff-source gap <=1500ms.
support_rules.trailing_60s: Every integral second from selected_source-60s through selected_source inclusive must exist.
support_rules.trailing_300s: Every integral second from selected_source-300s through selected_source inclusive must exist.
support_rules.kernel_checkpoint_supported: Current source selection, trailing_60s, and trailing_300s are all supported.
support_rules.settlement_window: Every integral second in [close-60s,close) must exist, exactly 60 timestamps.
support_rules.market_all_horizons_supported: All three fixed analysis checkpoints are supported.
support_rules.no_substitution: Never interpolate, carry forward, use a neighboring 200ms tick, use every fifth row, or use market/metadata price as a BRTI replacement.

outputs.support_manifest: Per market and fixed horizon: cutoff timestamp, selected source timestamp, source gap, trailing-window support booleans/missing counts, settlement support boolean/missing count, final support boolean, and categorical reasons. No prices, probabilities, outcomes, strikes, or PnL.
outputs.receipt: Source hashes, hour-level projected timestamp counts/missing timestamp lists, and market/checkpoint support counts. No prices.
outputs.decision: This diagnostic does not run calibration. A new analysis preregistration may bind the support-manifest SHA and exclude any unsupported market-checkpoint.
